subject: alt-f
title: (R)ALT.F.------PROG.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 126 (T(AF)M-30). ALT-F (alternative functionalism) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the partner. The main line bends at a junction labelled CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics), which has no dot of its own, so the path runs from the subject to CULT-INFO-DY and from there to PROG-CONT. AFTF (affinity transfer) is on a dotted line from CULT-INFO-DY. From CULT-INFO-DY: INFO-DE-B (information degrees). VT-IMP (vibrational implications) is on a dotted line from PROG-CONT. From VT-IMP: ALT-C. From ALT-C: RT-ALIN and RE-DIF (redefinitions), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion".
